ios.desc:
HelloAria is your AI-powered to do list, reminders & calendar planner in one simple app. Chat with Aria to manage tasks, schedule events, take notes & sync with Google Calendar, Outlook & more. Your smart productivity organizer across all devices.

MEET ARIA - YOUR AI PRODUCTIVITY ASSISTANT
Talk to Aria like a friend. Create reminders, add tasks to your checklist, schedule calendar events, or take notes - all through natural conversation. Aria understands what you need and gets it done instantly.

SMART REMINDERS
  • Contact Reminders - Set reminders for specific people
  • Circle Reminders - Remind your family, friends, or work groups
  • Recurring reminders - Daily, weekly, monthly, or yearly
  • Voice call alerts with text-to-speech
  • Never forget birthdays, meetings, or important tasks

POWERFUL TO DO LIST & TASKS
  • Create multiple todo lists with categories
  • Assign tasks to contacts or circles
  • Track progress with completion percentages
  • Share checklists with your team or family
  • Simple swipe actions to complete or delete
  • Turn any chat into actionable tasks

UNIFIED CALENDAR PLANNER
  • Sync Google Calendar & Outlook Calendar
  • View events by day, week, or month
  • Morning, afternoon, evening & night organization
  • Create events with attendees & Google Meet links
  • See all your schedules in one agenda view

QUICK NOTES & MEETING MINUTES
  • Capture notes instantly via chat or dedicated note-taking
  • Record meetings with automatic transcription
  • AI-generated meeting summaries
  • Tag and organize your notebook
  • Search across all your notes
  • Grid or list view - your choice

SEAMLESS INTEGRATIONS
  • Google Calendar, Drive, Meet & Gmail
  • Outlook Calendar & Mail
  • Connect your productivity tools in one place

USE ARIA EVERYWHERE
  • iOS App - Full-featured mobile experience
  • Web App - Access from any browser
  • Desktop - Windows & Mac support
  • WhatsApp - Chat with Aria directly
  • Telegram - Chat and organize your day with Aria 
  • Email - Send tasks via email

CONTACTS & CIRCLES
  • Organize contacts into circles (Family, Friends, Work)
  • Assign reminders to contacts & groups
  • Assign todos to contacts

WHY HELLOARIA?
HelloAria combines the power of an AI chat assistant with a complete productivity organizer. Unlike basic reminder apps or simple to do list apps, Aria understands context. Say "remind me to call mom every Sunday at 5 pm" or "add milk to my grocery list" - Aria handles it naturally.

show_hn.title: Show HN: HelloAria – AI task manager where you talk instead of type

quotes.text:
I built HelloAria because every task manager I tried required too many steps to do something simple.
The core idea: say "remind me to review the PR tomorrow at 10" and it creates the task, sets the reminder, and files it. No forms, no manual input.
It works on iOS natively and also through WhatsApp, Telegram, and email — so you can capture tasks from wherever you already are.
Tech stack: Swift/SwiftUI on the client, with NLP handling the intent parsing and entity extraction from natural language input.
Looking for feedback from the HN community. What would make this actually useful for your workflow?
App Store: : https://apps.apple.com/us/app/helloaria-reminders-to-dos/id6757361279
